The company's core marketplace enables hospitals and healthcare organizations to cover workforce needs through verified professionals, while AI already supports operational workflows such as matching, shift recommendations, support automation, and candidate interactions. About The Role You will own a core multi-sided marketplace product end to end, working closely with company leadership and the marketplace business team. This is a hands-on product role focused on outcomes rather than delivery management. You will work directly with users and enterprise customers, understand marketplace dynamics in depth, and design product and AI-driven solutions that reduce manual coordination across operational workflows. The ideal candidate has already built and deployed AI agents in real production environments and understands how to use automation responsibly within operational processes. Key Responsibilities Own a core marketplace product end to end, from discovery through launch and iteration. Work directly with healthcare professionals, enterprise customers, and internal operational teams. Analyze supply, demand, liquidity, matching, incentives, and trust across a multi-sided marketplace. Identify operational workflows that can be improved or automated through AI. Design and deploy AI agents that reduce manual coordination and improve marketplace efficiency. Define product priorities based on user behavior, operational data, and measurable business outcomes. Partner closely with engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders. Conduct direct user research and field visits when needed. Measure product performance and continuously improve marketplace outcomes. Operate with high autonomy in a small, founder-led product organization. Required Qualifications 4+ years of Product Management experience working on marketplaces, platforms, or multi-sided products. Strong understanding of marketplace concepts including supply, demand, liquidity, matching, incentives, and trust. Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents into real operational workflows. Experience working directly and regularly with users and enterprise customers. Comfort conducting field research and translating operational problems into product solutions. Ability to own outcomes rather than simply manage tickets, roadmaps, or delivery processes. Strong analytical and product judgment. Ability to work effectively in a small, fast-moving organization with significant ownership. Fluent Spanish. Particularly Relevant Experience Marketplaces involving supply-and-demand matching. Workforce, staffing, mobility, delivery, logistics, or similar operational platforms. AI agents used to automate real business processes. Products involving scheduling, matching, incentives, or operational coordination. High-growth technology companies with small product teams. Ideal Candidate Profile This role is best suited to a product leader who wants to stay close to users, data, engineering, and operational reality. You should be comfortable making product decisions directly, testing them with users, and measuring their impact rather than operating primarily as a project coordinator or delivery manager. Practical AI experience is important. The company is specifically looking for someone who has already put AI agents into production workflows and can discuss what worked, what failed, and how human oversight and product safeguards were handled. Compensation Base salary between €70,000 and €100,000 gross annually, depending on experience. Equity participation. Work Arrangement This opportunity is based in Barcelona, Spain . The exact on-site versus hybrid working arrangement is still being confirmed. Candidates should therefore consider this a Barcelona-based role rather than a remote-first opportunity. Application If your background aligns with this opportunity, please submit your application through this same channel . Please include: Your updated CV or resume. Your gross annual compensation expectations in EUR. A brief example of an AI agent or AI-enabled operational workflow you have personally helped launch into production.

Key Responsibilities • Create visual assets for multi-channel campaigns, including social media, websites, presentations, print materials, event branding, and digital experiences. • Lead the visual development of assigned projects from concept through final execution. • Develop and maintain brand guidelines to ensure consistency across all touchpoints. • Collaborate closely with creative directors, copywriters, strategists, developers, and account teams to bring ideas to life. • Mentor junior designers and provide constructive feedback during internal reviews. • Present creative concepts and design rationale to internal stakeholders and clients when required. • Stay updated on emerging design trends, technologies, and creative tools to ensure innovative output. • Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining quality standards and meeting deadlines. • Contribute ideas and creative thinking beyond design execution to support overall campaign effectiveness. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) • Quality, originality, and effectiveness of creative outputs. • Timely delivery and accuracy of assigned projects. • Collaboration and feedback from internal teams. • Client satisfaction with creative deliverables. • Contribution to successful pitches, campaign performance, and business growth. • Innovation, creative thinking, and proactive contribution to the agency's creative culture.

review_candidates.title: Sales and Application Specialist
review_candidates.description: Carl Zeiss BeNeLux is looking for an Sales and Application Specialist to sell and to provide product advice, training, and application support for its ZEISS Vitreoretinal product portfolio. You will represent ZEISS at our clients in Wallonia and Luxembourgish hospitals and private clinics. You will work in various locations, and every day will be different. You will collaborate closely with other colleagues, account managers and field service engineers within our Benelux structure. You will report directly to the Sales Manager Medical technology. The key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to): Manage the complete sales journey with all stakeholders in the accounts in your region with the aim to: Close deals successfully in order to achieve the sales and margin targets Provide accurate business forecasts for your region Providing product and application support for ZEISS Vitreoretinal products. Delivering presentations, training sessions at client sites, and product demonstrations during conferences, workshops or at ZEISS demo facilities. Assisting in finding the right solutions for customers to ensure maximum customer satisfaction. Supporting the sales team, collaborating with marketing colleagues and working with our Field Service Engineers to provide solutions for clients in case of malfunctions or repairs. Remaining up-to-date with the latest market trends and communicating these to other colleagues (Product Management, R&D) at ZEISS headquarters Germany. Required Knowledge & Experience You hold a bachelor’s degree in a commercial, technical, biomedical or product-related field, or have equivalent experience. You have a background in ophthalmology, for example as an operating room assistant, biomedical engineer, or in a similar role within the medical device industry. You have experience providing training and working in an operating room environment. You are a proactive and customer-focused professional who enjoys working independently and translating customer needs into effective solutions. You are well-organized, able to manage responsibilities, and remain calm and effective under pressure. You are fluent in French and have a good command of English. You hold a valid driver's license (B) and are willing to travel frequently to customer sites across the region. You preferably reside in the Wallonia region. Our Benefits An attractive salary in line with the role; An annual bonus paid in cash or warrants; Extra-legal benefits, such as an extensive insurance package; A Flexible Income Plan (FIP), allowing you to tailor part of your compensation package to your personal needs; 25 vacation days; A comfortable company car with fuel or charging card; An iPhone, laptop and iPad, including subscription; Training and development opportunities; A fun annual kick-off with the entire Benelux organization. Who Are We ZEISS Benelux In the Benelux we operate in 2 locations: Breda in the Netherlands and Leuven in Belgium. In total, around 200 employees work in the Benelux. We have a beautiful headquarter in Breda which connects us through open communication, pride in our products and innovations and a pleasant working atmosphere. ZEISS Group ZEISS is a world leader in optics and optoelectronics. Last financial year, revenue was EUR 10 billion divided between the Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology and Consumer Markets divisions. The product portfolio includes microscopy solutions for life science and material sciences, multidimensional metrology, medical technologies for ophthalmology and microsurgery, spectacle lenses, camera lenses, binoculars and telescopes. In addition, 80% of the world's microchips are manufactured using ZEISS optical lithography. ZEISS has approx. 43,000 employees and is represented in almost 50 countries with 30 production sites, 60 Sales & Service offices and 27 R&D facilities . We are proud of our heritage and have been at the forefront of scientific discovery and innovation since our creation in 1846. The Carl Zeiss Foundation, one of the largest foundations in Germany committed to the promotion of science, is the sole owner of the holding company, Carl Zeiss AG. The long-term goal of the Carl Zeiss Foundation is to bring science and society into the future together. This means we reinvest 12% of our revenue to fund research and education, supporting progress within the optical industry and across the community. ZEISS believes that innovation and technology are the key to a sustainable future and solutions for global change. Your ZEISS Recruiting Team Veerle Vermeulen

La persona seleccionada desempeñará un papel clave en la expansión del negocio dentro del sector público en España, liderando la captación de nuevas oportunidades y actuando como asesor de confianza para clientes institucionales y stakeholders del sector. Buscamos un perfil senior, con expertise desarrollando negocio en Administraciones Públicas con sólida experiencia en desarrollo de negocio en entornos complejos y regulados, y con una clara orientación a resultados y construcción de relaciones estratégicas a largo plazo. Responsabilidades del puesto: Impulsar, liderar y ejecutar la estrategia de crecimiento de Public Services (PS) en España, con un fuerte foco en generación de nuevo negocio, diseño estratégico de soluciones y crecimiento de ingresos dentro del mercado público español. Identificar, cualificar, desarrollar y convertir oportunidades estratégicas del sector público en organismos nacionales, regionales y locales, construyendo un pipeline sólido y sostenible de oportunidades transformacionales de outsourcing. Liderar análisis de mercado, posicionamiento competitivo y estrategias de penetración de cuentas para ampliar la presencia y cuota de mercado dentro del sector público español. Desarrollar y ejecutar la estrategia GTM (Go-To-Market) de PS para España. Construir y fortalecer las capacidades de PS en España involucrando y alineando a los equipos de liderazgo locales, incluyendo CEO, CCO, Operaciones, Finanzas, RRHH y otras funciones de soporte. Colaborar con stakeholders globales de PS y unidades especializadas de negocio para desarrollar soluciones integradas, diferenciadas y comercialmente atractivas para oportunidades complejas del sector público. Liderar el ciclo completo de las oportunidades comerciales, incluyendo: identificación y cualificación de oportunidades, desarrollo de estrategia de cuentas, creación de estrategias, diseño de soluciones y estructuración comercial, liderazgo y gobernanza de ofertas, revisión y presentación de propuestas, negociaciones y soporte en adjudicación de contratos Actuar como líder estratégico de soluciones, transformando retos de negocio, requerimientos operativos y aspectos regulatorios en soluciones escalables de outsourcing y transformación alineadas con las prioridades del sector público. Construir y mantener relaciones con stakeholders clave del sector público, asesores sectoriales, lobbies, asociaciones, analistas, responsables de procurement y partners del ecosistema en España. Desarrollar y aprovechar una sólida red profesional dentro del ecosistema público español para identificar tendencias emergentes, oportunidades de financiación, cambios regulatorios e iniciativas estratégicas relevantes para PS. Utilizar inteligencia de mercado, insights de clientes y análisis competitivo para desarrollar propuestas de valor sólidas y soluciones diferenciadas para el mercado público español. Impulsar mejores prácticas, gobernanza, estándares de calidad y mejora continua en todas las oportunidades y proyectos de PS en España. Liderar la innovación y evolución del enfoque de diseño de soluciones de PS en España, asegurando alineación con expectativas del cliente, excelencia operativa, requerimientos regulatorios y tendencias de mercado. Requisitos (H/M/D): Más de 8 años de experiencia demostrable en desarrollo de negocio para sector público, outsourcing, BPO, CX o entornos de servicios transformacionales. Nivel muy alto de inglés y español (oral y escrito). Mínimo C1. Perfil Hunter. Sólida trayectoria en generación de nuevo negocio, incluyendo identificación proactiva, desarrollo y conversión de oportunidades estratégicas en el sector público. Experiencia demostrada construyendo y gestionando pipelines cualificados, abriendo nuevas cuentas, expandiendo relaciones existentes y cerrando acuerdos complejos y de alto valor en entornos regulados. Capacidad demostrada para desarrollar y ejecutar estrategias de penetración y crecimiento de cuentas, con una mentalidad altamente comercial y orientada a oportunidades. Experiencia demostrable originando, estructurando y ganando oportunidades complejas y estratégicas en el sector público. Conocimiento sólido del ecosistema del sector público español, procesos de procurement, frameworks y entorno regulatorio. Experiencia liderando o apoyando licitaciones complejas del sector público, concursos competitivos y proyectos de outsourcing a gran escala. Alta capacidad comercial con experiencia desarrollando estrategias de crecimiento, impulsando generación de ingresos y posicionando soluciones diferenciadas de outsourcing en mercados competitivos. Capacidad demostrada para transformar retos de negocio de clientes en soluciones convincentes de outsourcing y transformación. Sólidas capacidades de networking y construcción de relaciones dentro del ecosistema público, incluyendo experiencia trabajando con lobbies, asesores, asociaciones sectoriales, responsables de procurement e influenciadores políticos. Red consolidada de contactos dentro del entorno público español y europeo. Capacidad para influir, involucrar y generar credibilidad con stakeholders senior tanto internos como externos, incluyendo ejecutivos C-Level, autoridades de procurement y responsables gubernamentales. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación, negociación y gestión de stakeholders.
